from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program=program_dir/'task-cd9c2046.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    patterns = []
    for r in {0, h - 1}:
        row = grid[r]
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            patterns.append(row[start:c])

    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if value == 0:
                continue
            candidates = [p for p in patterns if value in p]
            if not candidates:
                continue
            # Each isolated symbol identifies the edge sequence containing it.
            pattern = candidates[0]
            start = c - pattern.index(value)
            for i, color in enumerate(pattern):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
program.write_text(code)
print(program, program.read_text())
